info.name: Storage App v2
info.description: Backend API for Storage App v2. Auth uses httpOnly cookies — keep cookies on in Postman.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Register, login, OTP, Google, logout. Add requests as the auth module is built.

item.name: Users
item.description: Current user and admin user management. Add requests as the user module is built.
